pr_title: Using default pager in gh pr diff
pr_body:
Closes #1100

Changes:
- Using user's default pager for displaying PR diffs by checking `PAGER` env variable
- If no pager is configured it works as before

Steps for testing this PR:
- `export PAGER='less -R';`
- Run `gh pr diff <pr-id>`
pr_comments: My fault @mislav, next time will do the commit surgery after the rounds of review-and-update so you have a clear history. Thanks for the detailed feedback 🙏

issue_context.title: gh pr diff could use default pager
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

`gh pr diff` (#962) is awesome! But it produces colorized standard diffs, which aren't super pretty.

### Proposed solution

I'd love it if it used my default configuration for `core.pager`, so I could get the nice formatting of [delta](https://github.com/dandavison/delta/) or [diff-so-fancy](https://github.com/so-fancy/diff-so-fancy), as I do when I `git diff`.

### Additional context

I'm working around this by passing to my pager explicitly:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3347530/83772393-f1a1f280-a648-11ea-97ca-9b2d0ea2d025.png)
comments: great idea and exactly the kind of improvement I was hoping to follow this work with :+1:
I figured, since you explicitly said "doesn't use the pager" in the PR. I didn't realize the easy workaround until filing this so hopefully that's helpful to someone else in the mean time!
I'm confused. If this function is implemented, can I use vimdiff to view diff?
